'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[map clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]].

In order to enter the underwater area, the player must equip a [[fishbowl helmet]] and a [[diving apparatus]] (a [[medallion of the deep]] can replace these two items) and weigh less than 28 kilograms, and speak to [[Murphy]] at [[Port Khazard]] to go diving.
